title: FIXX YA FACE FRIDAYS | AS WAS SUPPOSED!!

sense.text:
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments.” You cannot have a good understanding if you are not keeping the commandments. It is biblically impossible to have a good understanding of the Bible while you are not observing the laws of God. There is no way around it: the only way you understand this Bible is if you do what God said.

That is why so much foolishness comes out of men who call themselves teachers. All of it is due to those that refuse to repent and keep God's commandments. They deny Christ and they deny keeping the commandments because they want to fulfil their own lust, so they come up with absurd breakdowns of the scriptures and bring shame on this movement. If we want understanding, we must keep the commandments. That is basic, and it is not hard.

precepts.why:
“From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.” Christ's first preaching was repentance, because the kingdom is at hand, and repentance is turning back to the commandments that give the good understanding of Psalm 111.

So many of our brothers and sisters in the world have yet to come to grips with what we are here for. Being an Israelite in Christ is not about dressing up as an Israelite. It is not about arguing with white folks in the streets, flexing your muscles and trying to be a tough guy, and it is not about multiple wives. Being an Israelite in Christ is observing the Most High God's commandments and having faith in his Son, so that we don't die when the Lord returns.

The kingdom of heaven is at hand. You are at risk if you do not repent and seek the kingdom. Point blank, period.

sense.text: “For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?” Men who cannot answer a question from the Bible start freestyling: they claim there are multiple wives in the New Testament and point to 1 Corinthians 5, where nothing of the kind is found, and never acknowledge that Paul addressed it in 1 Corinthians 7 and in the bishops and deacons being the husband of one wife. Their unbelief does not change what God said.

“God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written”. As Israelites united in Christ we let God be true. You cannot bend and twist the Bible and make it into what you want it to be; you have to accept it as it is written. That is where we stay and where we live, and we are not budging from it. Whenever we say something that God said, we go back to the scripture and justify ourselves with thus saith the Lord. If you try to do it any other type of way, you are evil.

“That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings”. So when they ask why we have only one wife, the answer is: because the Lord said so, and we take them to the scripture where the Lord said one wife. Keep it biblical. Don't add to it, don't remix it, don't look for a loophole. Keep it as it is written.

“If thou hast understanding, answer thy neighbour; if not, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.” When you are asked a question and you understand, and you know where in the Bible it speaks of it, give answer. If you are asked and you don't know, shut up. That is what laying your hand upon your mouth means: if you don't know, it is best to be quiet.

You don't get to freestyle or go off the top of your head; you have to speak truth to your neighbour, and that is the law. A man asked about Luke 3:23, as was supposed, and instead of pulling the scripture he made up that Jacob and Heli were brothers and that Heli was Joseph's father by levirate marriage. Somebody was supposed to say, shut your lip and pull the script: show me in Luke 3 and Matthew 1 that Jacob and Heli were brothers. You don't read that anywhere in the Bible.

I don't care how composed you look or how unbothered you make yourself appear. If you don't know what you are talking about, shut up. Some of our people are so prideful they want to look like the gurus with all the answers. If there is something you don't know, go find out; pick up the phone and ask. There is no shame in that.

“And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob”. Here Eliud is the father of Eleazar, and neither one of them is mentioned in Luke 3. In Matthew 1 the father of Matthan is Eleazar; in Luke 3 the father of Matthat is Levi, and Levi's father is Melchi. Even if Matthan and Matthat are the same man spelled differently by different authors, the fathers do not line up. This is a totally different lineage, two completely different bloodlines, so Jacob and Heli cannot be brothers.

“And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary”. Jacob is the father of Joseph. Matthew follows Joseph: the angel comes to Joseph and the book follows his story, so Joseph's lineage is the one given in Matthew 1, and women are named in it.

This is the kind of reading false teachers do not expect you to do: bounce back and forth and make sure things line up. They are banking on your stupidity to the utmost of their ability. You are not supposed to weigh what they say or fact check them; you are just supposed to say, oh, okay. Read precept upon precept, and fix your whole face for believing that nonsense. It ain't biblical.

precepts.why: “The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.” This is the lineage of Christ. It is the linkage between Christ and the royal seat, his rightful place, and the prophecy spoken in 2 Samuel 7 concerning the Messiah coming through David's loins. It bridges the gap.

“And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse; And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias”. The kingship went through King David to his son King Solomon. The Messiah, the rightful heir to the throne, would come through David, through Solomon and through their sons.

If you know anything about levirate marriage, you would see it took place at this time concerning Ruth. But we are not going to be bamboozled by spin moves: you don't pull an Old Testament law that has nothing to do with the question that was asked, which had nothing to do with Heli.

“And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph”. Did it say the son of Heli? No. The “as was supposed” is about Christ being the son of Joseph. It had nothing to do with Heli. That man hit the crossover, hopped over Joseph and spun to Heli, and called him Jacob's brother.

Read on: “which was the son of Heli, Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi”. Matthat's father is Levi, but in Matthew 1 Matthan's father is Eleazar. Uh oh. As was supposed.

The author of Luke decided to follow Mary. Luke begins with her and her cousin Elizabeth, how they linked up and the babe leaped in her womb, and it follows her story down to the third chapter, where it goes through her lineage concerning all men. That is why not one woman is named in Luke 3, while some women are named in Matthew 1. When it got to where it would say Mary, it said her husband. That was the author's decision. Two different lineages: Joseph's in Matthew, Mary's in Luke.

sense.text:
“Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin”. Look at what these men keep touching: multiple wives, making every excuse in the book, saying biologically men have an outie and women an innie so a man was made to dominate more than one woman. They are not humble, because their mindset is not sincere. They are here to look for loopholes and to get in the sisters' drawers, straight up.

“beguiling unstable souls”. That is why nobody questions these men: the souls following behind them are unstable themselves, so they cannot go to the book, make sense of it and study to show themselves approved unto God. “an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children”.

“Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor”. The right way is to keep God's commandments: not add to them, not make it up on the spot, not create an alternate reality to fit what you want to do. Our people need to repent. Brothers, repent and stop making stuff up, because you are looking crazy.

precepts.why:
“To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.” How do you know whether a man is speaking according to the word? You have to study. It is the obligation of everyone in this truth before God to study to show thyself approved unto God, rightly dividing the word of truth.

This is elementary: Matthew 1 and Luke 3 put together answer the question. Yet people sat and listened to that breakdown and nobody asked a question. These men do not keep the commandments and do not know the Bible, and opening the Bible is kryptonite to them. That goes for all of us too: we are not above it, and we must repent and keep these commandments as it is written.

sense.text: “My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments”. A man of understanding is selective in what he does. A brother who calls himself a leader goes onto a platform that has no interest in edifying the truth and says something dumb, and now the world equates that with all Israelites, and other brothers look at him and say, I thought he was a leader. Brothers get put on these platforms and don't realize they are being used to defame this truth.

precepts.why: “So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.” Keeping the law gives good understanding in the sight of men. Here is an Israelite elder, a leader, who does not look in front of men like he has understanding. We shouldn't have to talk about this. You are still our brother, but you are an embarrassment, and you let them embarrass the Israelites.

“Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.” You are wise in your own eyes. You think you are saying something deep, and you look crazy: an unsolved Rubik's cube bouncing around in your cerebellum.

sense.text: “The inner parts of a fool are like a broken vessel, and he will hold no knowledge as long as he liveth.” These brothers have lost all wisdom out of their vessel, if they ever obtained it at all. That is why foolishness spews out of their mouths. Israel must understand that this line will not go throughout the earth. The blueprint is simple: the secret sauce is keeping the commandments.

“If a skilful man hear a wise word, he will commend it, and add unto it: but as soon as one of no understanding heareth it, it displeaseth him, and he casteth it behind his back.” When a man of no understanding hears the commandments and that he must keep them, it displeaseth him, and he casts it behind his back. That is what we are looking at: every manner of foolishness coming out of these brothers' mouths, down to an elder saying he will hire himself out as the Hebrew Hammer if the people don't pay their tithes.

“Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth”. Only people that don't study follow behind this foolishness, and there were people in the room agreeing with it. It isn't just one man; it is all those that resist the truth.

Why do these dumb doctrines and silly sayings come out? “men of corrupt minds”. Because they have resisted the truth, their minds have become corrupt. It is clear that we don't tithe anymore, because the temple is not there. It is clear that you don't have multiple wives; you read that in 1 Corinthians 7. They resist the truth, and so you hear about innies and outies and all the rest.

“reprobate concerning the faith.” These men are not in the faith. They don't believe, and anyone who gets caught up with them is in that same boat.
“But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all”. They are not going to proceed any further, and their folly is being made manifest among all men.

“Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure”. Say for argument's sake he needs to raise money to take care of the kids. How does that translate into selling your body when Diddy gets out? His mind is corrupt. “but even their mind and conscience is defiled.” Every time, it turns into some weird energy of gayness and sex. It's dark. And nobody beside him says anything: no friend to take the mic and cut the feed.

“They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.” If a comment like that were made among us, the congregation would not laugh. We are not perfect, but we are not of that sort. He called himself a prostitute; that is not a joke, it is unseemly. He is a demon, and the brothers under him who edited it and put it out don't even love him.

“There is that destroyeth his own soul through bashfulness, and by accepting of persons overthroweth himself.” This is for everyone who was in that room. Silence is agreement. If you hear that type of talk and it doesn't compel you to speak up and say, hey, did anybody else hear that, then you are silent, and that day everybody in that room just got gay, because they sat there and said nothing.

That is what a lot of you are doing: destroying your own souls because you are scared to speak up, and respecting a man's person over God's word. There is no Bible open. It is time to wake up, realize who is leading you down the road of destruction, separate, and do the Father's will. Stop following behind brothers who want to be the new Hebrew Hammer. That is a defiled nasty negro.

“Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.” A man was asked to break down this verse and taught that deeds and works are what you have done and faith is what you do, as if a man comes home and asks his son or his wife to show him their deeds. That is not a marriage; that is a supervisor and an employee. He is an idiot, and whoever listens to him needs to repent.

The works are the sacrificial law, the works they did in the service of the house of God. You cannot boast that you were sacrificing, as if it made you special. You can't, because it is done: Christ died for us. Boasting is excluded through Christ, by the law of faith.

“Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.” The deeds of the law are the sacrifices brought to the house of God. A man is justified by faith in Christ without them, and the same chapter says, as it is written, that God might be justified in his sayings. This is serious: your salvation is at hand. A leader at the podium drinking and talking about sex, baby oil and prostitution is not instructing the people what these scriptures are talking about. He is not a leader to lead people to God; he is a joke.

precepts.why: “And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God”. The works are the service of the house of God: the sacrificial law. Hezekiah's works were done in the house of God, and the law and the commandments are how he sought his God.

“And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service”. Every man according to his service to do the works of God in the temple of God. Those are the works of the law that Romans 3 says no man can boast in.

“Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken?” This is about the house of God. “Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.” That is what they brought: the sacrifices.

Nehemiah set treasurers over the treasuries, “for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.” Then he says, “Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds”. The deeds were the sacrifices he brought to the house of God. So the deeds of the law in Romans 3:28 are those offerings, and a man is now justified by faith without them.

sense.text:
How do you identify a leader? You can tell who a man is by his speech. “Leaders of the people by their counsels”: you should be able to tell by their godly counsel, coming from the Bible, whether or not they are leaders of the people. Everything the leaders of Israel United in Christ say, they can prove with the scriptures. Why are you sitting under a man who talks about baby oil and cannot break down Romans 3?

“and by their knowledge of learning meet for the people”: Bishop Kani showed the works from 2 Chronicles and the deeds from Nehemiah 13. “wise and eloquent are their instructions”. The Bible is the rubric that lets us know who the guys are and who are not.

“Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.” This is one of the first scriptures we learned when we came into this truth, and it is elementary. An elder has men under him looking to him for wisdom, knowledge and understanding. This brother embarrassed himself and his organization, and because he represents the Israelite community, the world labels all of us by him. Never trust a man wearing dark sunglasses inside: he can hide his embarrassment and his eyes. Brother, repent and change your ways.

“But shun profane and vain babblings”. What he said is profane and vain babbling; it doesn't make any sense. And nobody of his rank in the room corrects him, which is why he keeps the same pattern. Among Israel United in Christ there are checks and balances: if Captain Zakar starts talking some crazy stuff, Captain Aariah, who is junior to him, is going to correct him, because our elders have taught us with knowledge, wisdom and understanding how to conduct ourselves.

“Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God”. We often read this about the Christian church, but it speaks of anyone who fits the description: anyone who says he believes in Christ, believes the Bible, or says he is an Israelite. You try the spirit with the Bible, and many are not doing that, especially those who cosign these men. Every spirit is not of Christ, and Christian pastors say the same things as some Israelite leaders.

“because many false prophets are gone out into the world.” That is what you see: false prophets and false teachers saying all kinds of nonsense.

precepts.why:
“For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation”. Everybody who picks up a Bible is not called or sent by God; some picked it up because they were before ordained. That is their lot. God created them for this reason, to be a proving ground for you: whether you will follow man or follow the word of God. He sends them to try you.

“ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness”. The grace of God is our being called into this truth, knowing that we are Israelites. If men come to you saying they speak on behalf of God, and most of their conversation is being the sidekick to the diddler and selling their bodies, question whether they are really sent by God or ordained of old to try you. Are they living up to the scriptures and speaking according to what the scriptures say? Examine that, brothers and sisters.

sense.text:
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge”. These so-called leaders don't even use the Bible. Every time they talk or try to teach it is pride, and when they do try to use the Bible, they make something up. You show your fear of the Lord, and that you have knowledge, by sitting down and reading. These men have no Bibles in front of them; everything is made up off the top of the dome, full of pride and full of lasciviousness.

There is no fear of the Lord there. They will not follow wisdom or basic instructions; they will not look in the book. Everything is of the flesh, the sensual and carnal side of them. They go on podcast interviews, freestyle the whole interview and nothing biblical comes out, and the people equate them with other Israelites. See the chess move: Satan puts these things in place so someone will add affliction to our bonds. We will not sit back. We correct all folly, whether from so-called Christians or brothers in this truth, without partiality.

“And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints”. Christianity, trying to sound deep, talks cold hard cash about Christ, even preaching that the only stripper they reverence is Jesus, and pictures him as a white hippie. That ain't the Son of God. Jesus is a black man. He comes with ten thousands of his saints: off top, he rode deep. He got a posse, he got a crew.

“To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches”. People think that because judgment is not executed speedily, they can say whatever they want about Jesus. He has not returned yet, but he is getting it all written down in a book, and he is coming back to slap Negroes' faces off for calling him a stripper and making it rain on him. He is going to say, say that to my face. All of that talk about Jesus, calling him a stripper, is hard speeches. That is how you know Jesus is a black man.

precepts.why:
“A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.” What comes out of you shows what is in you.

“But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.” If you cannot prove it in the scriptures, you will give account for it. These are the hard speeches of Jude. “For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.” These men are condemning themselves.

We know Christianity is a lie, but it is not enough for them to say that Jesus gave his life for us; they have to say he was a stripper. They actually sit down and come up with these sermons, thinking they are saying something deep, when the Lord's laws are simple. Why go through all of that to concoct lies instead of keeping God's commandments, which is very easy to do?

sense.text:
“And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”. Instead of keeping and teaching God's commandments, they concoct so-called wise sayings to look a certain way in front of men. They are trying to bewitch you, dropping little things into your windows here and there, until you find yourself in a congregation where a man says Jesus is a stripper and you support it and see nothing wrong with it.

The people they are trying to reach have defiled minds. When you get people to laugh at something that foul, it is because it engages their spirit: you are tapping into something familiar to them that they have not rooted out. Our job is to lead them away from that mentality, and these men are trying to keep them in it.

“but they are not valiant for the truth”. All they have to do is keep God's commandments. Be valiant about doing what God actually tells you to do. When Christians are given the truth out of the Bible, they say, not my Jesus. But when a man called him a stripper, nobody said, not my Jesus. Everybody said amen.

precepts.why:
“The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so”. They know they are up there talking outside of the Bible: no Bible in his hand, just silly glasses and a loud outfit. And the people love to have it so, while they are not valiant for God's laws.

When Christ comes back you will suffer the consequences, because you had a space to repent and rejected it for a fool calling Christ a stripper instead of your Lord and Saviour. He will hold you accountable for what you did or did not do while you had the opportunity. This is the King of kings and Lord of lords, and they lowered him to the status of a woman selling her body in a strip club.
